original_ai_output.title_zh: 阿科尔·库尔将军住所外枪击事件伤者索赔34.115万美元
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 2024年11月，南苏丹朱巴前国家安全局内部安全局局长阿科尔·库尔·库克将军住所外发生安全部队交火，两名伤者现向国防与退伍军人事务部索赔合计34.115万美元。原告律师表示，其中一人索赔26.015万美元，另一人索赔8.1万美元，并另求精神损害、医疗及法律费用赔偿。朱巴一家法院预计于10月27日作出民事判决。该案目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 2024年11月朱巴阿科尔·库尔将军住所外发生安全部队交火，两人受伤
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Two people injured during an exchange of fire by security forces outside the residence of former National Security Service (NSS) Internal Security Bureau Chief Gen. Akol Koor Kuc in Juba in November 2024

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: are seeking a combined USD 341,150 in compensation from South Sudan’s Ministry of Defense and Veteran Affairs

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Manawa is seeking USD 260,150 in material compensation, while Gum is claiming USD 81,000

key_facts.evidence_excerpt: A court in Juba is expected to deliver its judgment in the civil case on Tuesday, October 27
